Note: Duplicate Counts may not be correct, here

```
tmp <- tmp[,c("sequence_id","VHH","junction_aa","duplicate_count", "clone_id", "source_file")]
# Hold another frame for collapsing VHHs
tmp_frame <- tmp[ ,c("VHH", "duplicate_count")]
# Drop duplicate count, as we will add it back later
tmp$duplicate_count <- NULL
# Aggregate
tmp_frame <- aggregate(duplicate_count ~ VHH, data = tmp_frame, FUN = sum)
# Merge back to other data
tmp <- merge(tmp_frame, tmp, by = "VHH")
# Drop duplicates
tmp <- tmp[!duplicated(tmp$VHH),]
```

#### Imports

```{r}
source("~/VHH/lib/utilities.R")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(stringdist))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggseqlogo))
```

## Load Data

```{r}
# Load cleaned database
clean_db <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/phylogenetic_dbs/translated_dbs/culled_databases/S18-clean-database02Apr24.csv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

# Load re-clustered outliers
outlier_db <- read.csv("~/Downloads/S18-outliers-re-clustered02Apr24.csv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
```

### Family Statistics:

1. `family_median_VHH_homology` - Statistic is defined as the VHH's percent homology to the family median VHH.

2. `family_median_CDR3_homology` - Statistic is defined as the CDR3's percent homology to the family median CDR3.

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
clean_db <- family_statistics(clean_db)
outlier_db <- family_statistics(outlier_db)
```

### Sub-Family Statistics:

3. `subfamily_median_VHH_homology` - Statistic is defined as the VHH's percent homology to its subfamily median VHH.

4. `subfamily_median_CDR3_homology`- Statistic is defined as the CDR3's percent homology to its subfamily median CDR3.

5. `VHH Homology Order Statistic` - After ordering VHH's by their `family_median_VHH_homology` (in the range 1 to the number of VHHs in the family), the `VHH Homology Order Statistic` can be used to access the VHH observation associated with it.

### Note: Cleaning can probably be added here, too

```{r, echo = F, eval = T, message = F, warning = F}

clean_test_db <- subfamily_statistics(clean_db)
outlier_test_db <- subfamily_statistics(outlier_db)
```

## Harmonize Outlier DB

For outliers, we will use their old `clone_id` and `centroid_id` values as prefixes to their new values.

```{r}
#outlier_test_db$clone_id <- paste(outlier_test_db$old_clone_id, '-', outlier_test_db$clone_id, sep = '')
#outlier_test_db$centroid_id <- paste(outlier_test_db$old_centroid_id, '-', outlier_test_db$centroid_id, sep = '')

# Clean column names
outlier_test_db <- outlier_test_db[colnames(outlier_test_db) %in% colnames(clean_test_db)]
```

### Add a large number to outlier clone IDs so they are distinguishable

```{r}
outlier_test_db$clone_id <- outlier_test_db$clone_id + 100000
outlier_test_db$centroid_id <- outlier_test_db$centroid_id + 100000
```

### Stack and Write

```{r}
clean_test_db$group <- rep("clean", each = nrow(clean_test_db))
outlier_test_db$group <- rep("outliers", each = nrow(outlier_test_db))


results <- rbind(clean_test_db, outlier_test_db)
```

```{r}
# Ordering
results <- results[order(results$family_median_VHH_homology, 
                         results$subfamily_median_VHH_homology, 
                         results$duplicate_count, 
                         decreasing = T),]

# Order statistic
results$order_index <- 1:nrow(results)

write.csv(results, file = "~/Downloads/S18-Cleaning-Reclustering-Initial-Results02Apr24.csv", row.names = F)
```
